title: Gintama: Shinyaku Benizakura-hen Special
justification: AniList 9735 is one 11-minute special on 2010-12-15, a synonym of its offline-database record is 'Gintama: Juudai Happyou' and 'Gintama: Benizakura Arc - A New Retelling'. AniDB 7177 S1 is 'Juudai Happyou' (重大発表) on 2010-12-15, and the parent's own row sends S1 to TVDB 79895 0x05 'Benizakura Arc', aired 2010-12-15. S2 'Prince Hata Dub version' (same date) is mapped to nothing by the row and is a different item.
